name: ChoreJar
welcome: A habit today. A dream tomorrow.
welcomeSub: Organize chores, celebrate progress and help their savings grow.
resetSent: If the account exists, you will receive a recovery email.
pairHelp: In your parent’s app, open your profile and tap “Link device”. Paste the code or link they share with you here.
previewHelp: This preview is saved only on this device. Role switching does not protect real data. Create an account to use the app with your family.
cloudOnly: This feature needs a connected account.
currencyHelp: One currency for the family. It is not converted or changed after creation.
noChildrenSub: Add a profile with a nickname. We do not need a date of birth.
allowanceHelp: Due periods are recorded when you open or refresh the parent area. They remain owed until you record the money given.
todaySub: At your pace. You can do this.
sent: Nice work! Your task is ready for review.
deliverHelp: Only record money already handed over outside the app.
cashOutAskHelp: Ask your parent for the money you have put toward this goal. Your goal will update after they approve it.
cashOutWaiting: Your parent needs to approve this cash out.
cashOutParentHelp: Confirm only after you give the cash or agree to the purchase. This lowers progress toward the goal.
reverseHelp: The original transaction stays and a reversal is added. Balances must remain zero or positive.
noGoalSub: Choose a goal with your parent.
goalSub: A little today, a little closer tomorrow.
savingsHelp: Saving moves available money. It does not create new income.
goalProgressHelp: Money you have and have not used counts toward your goal. Cashing out lowers the progress.
balanceHelp: Tasks in review are not approved money yet.
childFinanceHelp: Ask your parent to record money given, savings and expenses.
linkHelp: Single-use code. Expires in 10 minutes. Enter it on the child's device.
revokeHelp: Devices paired to this profile will lose access.
archiveHelp: History is kept. The child loses access and allowance pauses.
deleteHelp: Your family's profiles, tasks and transactions will be permanently deleted. Enter your password to confirm.
privacyText: Parents control profiles. We store nicknames, chores and money records in Firebase to sync them. The free version provides for non-personalized ads in the parent area. We do not send names, chores or balances to ads. There are no public profiles or bank transfers. You can unpair devices, archive profiles or delete your account and family data. Do not share parent access with children.
legalDataBody: We store the parent email, nicknames, chores, goals and money records to provide the family account and sync it across devices. We do not request bank details or create public profiles.
legalFamilyBody: The adult who creates the family controls child profiles, invitations and linked devices. Do not share parent access with children. Children do not need an email or password.
legalAdsBody: The free plan may show non-personalized ads only in the parent area. We do not send names, chores, goals or balances to ads. You may choose an ad-free plan when available.
legalRightsBody: You can unpair devices, archive profiles, and delete your account together with your family data from Settings. Deleting an account permanently removes the information stated in the confirmation.
legalNoticeBody: ChoreJar helps organize family chores and goals. It is not a bank, does not hold money, and does not process transfers. Parents decide how and when real money is given.
legalContactBody: For privacy questions or help with your data, contact sales@liisgo.com or visit chorejar-liisgo-2026.web.app/privacy.
legalAccept: I read the privacy information and accept ChoreJar's terms of use.
legalAcceptShort: I accept the privacy and terms.
legalAcceptHelp: You must accept before creating an account.
insufficient: There is not enough money for that transaction.
reversePaymentFirst: First reverse the payments allocated to this reward.
notDue: This task is scheduled for a future date.
permission: You do not have access to this profile.
historyFull: This profile reached this version's history limit. No transactions were deleted.
invalidCode: The code is invalid, used or expired.
signOutFirst: Sign out of the parent account before pairing a child.
connectionError: We could not connect. Check your internet connection and retry.
authError: Could not sign in. Check your email and password. If you do not have an account yet, tap “Create account”.
authInvalid: That email and password do not match. Passwords are case-sensitive; check capital letters or tap “Forgot password”.
emailInUse: This email already has an account. Use Sign in.
weakPassword: Use a password with at least 8 characters.
startEarning: Every chore brings your goal closer!
deleteChildWarning: This profile, its chores, transactions and savings goal will be permanently deleted. The child will lose access. This cannot be undone. Other children will not be changed. To keep the history, cancel and use Archive profile in Settings.
joinParentHelp: Paste the invitation you received. Your account must not already have a family.
inviteParentHelp: Share this code privately with the other parent. On the sign-in screen, select “I have an invitation from another parent” and sign in or create an account. The code expires in 10 minutes and works once. Both parents can manage children, chores and money.
parentPreviewHelp: You can invite the other parent in two steps: share the invitation and have them open it on their phone. Sign in first. This screen is only a demo.
twoParentsConnected: You and the other parent can now see the children and help with chores and savings.
removeParentHelp: Remove access for the second account? Children, chores and balances will be preserved.
twoParentsFull: This family already has two parents. Remove the second access before inviting someone else.
alreadyFamily: This account already belongs to a family. Use an account without a family to accept the invitation.
deleteSecondParentHelp: Your account and access will be deleted. Children and family data will be preserved.
inviteSimpleHelp: Send an invitation to the other parent. Both of you can see the children and help with their chores and savings.
shareStep1: 1. Tap Share invitation and choose who to send it to.
shareStep2: 2. The other parent opens the invitation and signs in with their own email. ChoreJar must be installed.
inviteExpires: The invitation lasts 10 minutes. If it expires, you can make another.
invitationMessage: Join our family in ChoreJar. Open this link with the app installed and sign in with your own email. If it does not open, copy this message and tap “Paste invitation” on the sign-in screen. Valid for 10 minutes:
shareFallback: Could not open sharing. Tap Copy invitation and paste it into a message.
invitedSubtitle: Sign in with your email to share the children’s chores and savings.
welcomeEasy: One step at a time. Getting started is easy.
alreadyAccount: I have an account · Sign in
childSetupHelp: Enter their name and choose a picture. You can add more children later.
childNameRequired: Enter your child’s name to continue.
firstTaskHelp: Choose a simple chore. You can change it or add more later.
rewardHelp: Enter the amount. Use 0 for a chore without a money reward.
optionalSetupHelp: Whenever you’re ready, use Settings to invite the other parent or connect your child’s phone. You don’t need to do it now.
wizardDemo: Demo: no email or password needed. Changes in this preview reset on reload.
browseGoals: Scroll to see all the choices.
freePlanDetails: Chores, allowances and goals. Banner in the parent area when available.
plansPending: Subscriptions are not available yet. You will not be charged. Final prices will come from your device’s store.
rewardDetails: Optional for parents: complete an ad to remove banners for 24 hours on this device. It does not change your children’s money, chores or savings.
rewardUnavailable: The ad was not completed or is unavailable. You can keep using the app.
childLinkWays: Choose how to connect your child’s phone or tablet.
childQrHelp: Use the camera on your child’s phone or tablet. Open the link and tap “Link”. The app must be installed.
childWifiHelp: Works over Wi-Fi: no SIM card or phone number needed. Both devices need internet; they can use different networks.
childShareMessage: Open this link on your child’s phone or tablet and tap Pair device. ChoreJar and internet are needed. Expires in 10 minutes.
linkSummary: Child’s phone or tablet · QR, message or code
linkAddChild: Add a child to link their device.
childDeviceHelp: Connected to your family. Your parents manage access from their app.
linkPreviewHelp: This is a local preview. To connect another device, sign in or create a parent account. Preview data stays here and is not sent to your account.
linkStepParent: 1. In your app: select your child and tap “Link device”.
linkStepChild: 2. On your child’s phone or tablet: open the link or scan the QR with the camera. They can also choose “I’m a child” and paste the code.
pairSubtitle: Ask your parent for help. You do not need an email or password.
authNetwork: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
authAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
authUnavailable: Sign-in is not available right now. Try again later.
alreadyLinked: This device is already linked to another profile. Open your profile and sign out before changing it.
pairLoadRetry: Your connection was saved, but the profile could not load. Check internet and tap Pair device again.
pairAccessRemoved: The parent removed access to this profile. Ask for a new invitation.
pairDenied: We could not validate this invitation. Ask your parent for a new link and try again.
